answer: Soot gets everywhere, and that is the point: a sweep who worked a flue carries the proof on his sleeves. Proof of chimney sweep certification via sweep guild register keeps proof the same way: a register the sweep guild has kept since the first flue inspection. Faking a single flue inspection takes a brush and a lie. Faking three hundred takes three hundred chimneys, three hundred roofs, and the shale of each house written down by someone who smelled the smoke — the nebula is the brush, worn down to the handle, the juniper the soot itself, which no liar can borrow.
